text: オーキドの　じいさんなら　いねーよ

structure.jp: オーキドの　じいさんなら

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら picks up the topic and says 'if that's what you mean'. じいさんなら = 'if it's the old man'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: いねー is a rough, casual spoken form of いない, 'isn't there'. いねーよ = 'he's not here, you know'.
